skill.summary: AgentRx recovery layer for AI agent tool failures. Use this skill whenever any external tool call fails, returns an error, times out, or behaves unexpectedly...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Clarified that AgentRx provides advisory suggestions for recovery, not authoritative commands.
- Updated security and privacy guidance for handling sensitive data and API keys.
- Enhanced instructions for agent evaluation of suggestions before acting, including confidence score thresholds and escalation requirements.
- Updated integration verification and API key usage documentation.
- Emphasized the trust model: agents must assess all recovery suggestions and protect against out-of-scope or risky actions.
